-- BOT DISGUISE SYSTEM (FULL ONE SCRIPT)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

------------------------------------------------
-- CHARACTER REFRESH HANDLING
------------------------------------------------
local char, humanoid, root

local function bindCharacter(c)
	char = c
	humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

bindCharacter(player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait())

------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------

	if not char then return end

	disguised = not disguised

	-- reset appearance if toggled off
	if not disguised then
		print("Disguise removed")
		return
	end

	-- remove accessories
	for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Accessory") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- simple NPC coloring
	local bodyColors = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")

		bodyColors.HeadColor3 = c
		bodyColors.LeftArmColor3 = c
		bodyColors.RightArmColor3 = c
		bodyColors.LeftLegColor3 = c
		bodyColors.RightLegColor3 = c
		bodyColors.TorsoColor3 = c
	end

	if head then

			face.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/face.png"
		end
	end

	print("Disguised as NPC")

local function trackDamage()
	if not humanoid then return end

	local lastHealth = humanoid.Health

	humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
		if h < lastHealth then
			-- find nearest “attacker”
			local closest, dist = nil, math.huge

			for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if plr ~= player and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					local d = (plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < dist and d < 60 then
						dist = d
						closest = plr.Character
					end
				end
			end

			lastAttacker = closest
		end

		lastHealth = h
	end)

	return workspace:FindFirstChild("TargetDummy")
end

	for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= player then
			local c = plr.Character
			if c and c:FindFirstChild("Head") and root then
				local head = c.Head
				local dir = (root.Position - head.Position).Unit
				local look = head.CFrame.LookVector
				if look:Dot(dir) > 0.75 then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function flee(attacker)
	if not attacker or not attacker:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
	local dir = (root.Position - attacker.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Unit
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 24
	humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position + dir * 60)

------------------------------------------------

	mode = box.Text
end)

controlBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	active = not active
	if active then
		trackDamage()
	end
end)

disguiseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(disguiseAsNPC)

------------------------------------------------
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not active then return end
	if not humanoid or not root then return end

	-- PRIORITY: FLEE IF ATTACKED
	if lastAttacker and lastAttacker.Parent then
		flee(lastAttacker)
		return
	end

	if mode == "Pathfind" then
		local target = getTarget()
		if target then
			humanoid:MoveTo(target.Position)
		end

	elseif mode == "Common" then
		if math.random(1,40) == 1 then
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-20,20),0,math.random(-20,20))
			humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position + offset)
		end

	elseif mode == "Sentient Entity" then
		if isBeingWatched() then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		else
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
		end
	end
end)

            flashFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 + (i / 10) * 0.65
        end

    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local burstParts = {}
        local burstHue = pixelHue

        -- Pixel shards (glitchy squares scatter outward + arc up)
        for i = 1, 28 do
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            local s = 0.18 + math.random() * 0.45
            p.Size = Vector3.new(s, s, s)
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CastShadow = false
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Color = Color3.fromHSV((burstHue + i/28) % 1, 1, 1)
            p.Parent = workspace
            local sa = math.random() * math.pi * 2
            local sr = math.random() * 2.5
            table.insert(burstParts, {
                part = p,
                sx = hrp.Position.X + math.cos(sa)*sr,
                sy = hrp.Position.Y + 2 + math.random()*3,
                sz = hrp.Position.Z + math.sin(sa)*sr,
                vx = math.cos(sa) * (4 + math.random()*6),
                vy = 5 + math.random() * 7,
                vz = math.sin(sa) * (4 + math.random()*6),
                isArrow = false,
            })
        end

        -- Upward arrow parts (thin vertical neon pillars floating up)
        for i = 1, 12 do
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 1.4, 0.1)
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CastShadow = false
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Color = Color3.fromHSV((burstHue + i/12) % 1, 1, 1)
            p.Parent = workspace
            local aa = (2*math.pi/12)*(i-1) + math.random()*0.4
            local ar = 1.2 + math.random() * 3
            table.insert(burstParts, {
                part = p,
                sx = hrp.Position.X + math.cos(aa)*ar,
                sy = hrp.Position.Y + 1.5 + math.random()*2,
                sz = hrp.Position.Z + math.sin(aa)*ar,
                vx = 0, vy = 9 + math.random()*5, vz = 0,

            for j = 1, 24 do

                table.insert(ringParts, {part=p, angle=ra, startR=0.5, ringY=ringH})
            end
        end

        -- Animate
        local steps = 24
        for step = 1, steps do
            local t = step / steps
            local alpha = 1 - t
            local dt = step * 0.017

            for _, b in ipairs(burstParts) do
                if b.part and b.part.Parent then
                    local gravity = b.isArrow and 0 or 5.5
                    b.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                        b.sx + b.vx * dt,
                        b.sy + b.vy * dt - gravity * dt * dt,
                        b.sz + b.vz * dt
                    )
                    b.part.Transparency = alpha
                    b.part.Color = Color3.fromHSV((burstHue + t*0.6 + step*0.02) % 1, 1, 1)
                end
            end

            -- Rings expand outward
            local ringR = t * 14
            for _, rp in ipairs(ringParts) do
                if rp.part and rp.part.Parent then
                    rp.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                        hrp.Position.X + math.cos(rp.angle) * ringR,
                        rp.ringY,

                    )
                    rp.part.Transparency = alpha
                    rp.part.Color = Color3.fromHSV((burstHue + t*0.4) % 1, 1, 1)
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.017)
        end

        for _, b in ipairs(burstParts) do

        end
        for _, rp in ipairs(ringParts) do

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
			end)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

			frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)

	end)

local positionHistory = {}

local function getRealPing()
    local ping = 0
    local pingSuccess, pingResult = pcall(function()
        return Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
    end)
    
    if pingSuccess and pingResult then
        ping = pingResult
    end
    
    return ping
end

local function addPositionToHistory(position)
    local currentTime = tick()
    table.insert(positionHistory, {
        position = position,
        time = currentTime
    })
    
    local maxHistory = math.ceil(2000 / (UPDATE_INTERVAL * 1000)) + 10
    if #positionHistory > maxHistory then
        table.remove(positionHistory, 1)
    end
end

local function getPositionAtTime(targetTime)
    if #positionHistory == 0 then
        return rootPart.Position
    end
    
    local closestIndex = 1
    local closestDiff = math.abs(positionHistory[1].time - targetTime)
    
    for i = 2, #positionHistory do
        local diff = math.abs(positionHistory[i].time - targetTime)
        if diff < closestDiff then
            closestDiff = diff
            closestIndex = i
        end
    end
    
    return positionHistory[closestIndex].position
end

local function updateFakeCharacter()
    if not character or not character.Parent then return end
    if not rootPart or not rootPart.Parent then return end
    
    local ping = getRealPing()
    ping = math.max(10, math.min(1000, ping))
    
    local pingDelay = ping / 1000
    
    addPositionToHistory(rootPart.Position)
    
    local serverTime = tick() - pingDelay
    
    local serverPosition
    if #positionHistory > 1 then
        serverPosition = getPositionAtTime(serverTime)
    else
        serverPosition = rootPart.Position
    end
    
    local currentCFrame = rootPart.CFrame
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(serverPosition) * (currentCFrame - currentCFrame.Position)
    fakeRootPart.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    updateFakeCharacter()
end)

        connection = nil
    end
    if fakeCharacter then

    end
end

	transformBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -160, 1, -80)
	transformBtn.Text = "TRANSFORM"
	transformBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	transformBtn.TextScaled = true
	transformBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
	transformBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	transformBtn.ZIndex = 10
	transformBtn.Parent = gui
	
	local corner4 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner4.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner4.Parent = transformBtn
	rainbowText(transformBtn)
	
	-- Botón SHOT TRANSFORMADO - APARECE DESPUÉS DE TRANSFORM
	local transformedShotBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	transformedShotBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 70)
	transformedShotBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0.7, -80)
	transformedShotBtn.Text = "SHOT"
	transformedShotBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	transformedShotBtn.TextScaled = true
	transformedShotBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	transformedShotBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	transformedShotBtn.ZIndex = 10
	transformedShotBtn.Visible = false
	transformedShotBtn.Parent = gui
	
	local corner5 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner5.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner5.Parent = transformedShotBtn
	rainbowText(transformedShotBtn)
	
	-- Botón TRANSFORM NORMAL - APARECE CON EL SHOT
	local normalTransformBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	normalTransformBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 70)
	normalTransformBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -160, 1, -80) -- MISMA POSICIÓN QUE TRANSFORM
	normalTransformBtn.Text = "TRANSFORM\nNORMAL"
	normalTransformBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	normalTransformBtn.TextScaled = true
	normalTransformBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255)
	normalTransformBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	normalTransformBtn.ZIndex = 10
	normalTransformBtn.Visible = false
	normalTransformBtn.Parent = gui
	
	local corner6 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner6.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner6.Parent = normalTransformBtn
	rainbowText(normalTransformBtn)
	
	local shooting = false
	local minigunActive = false
	local isDying = false
	local isTransforming = false
	local transformed = false
	local transformedShooting = false
	
	-- RELEASE GUN AND SHOT
	shootBtn.TouchTap:Connect(function()
		if shooting or minigunActive or isDying or isTransforming or transformed then return end
		shooting = true
		
		print("[GUNBOT] RELEASE AND SHOT activado")
		
		if runTrack then runTrack:Stop() end
		if idleTrack then idleTrack:Stop() end
		
		hum.WalkSpeed = 5
		
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			gunTrack:Play()
			gunTrack.Stopped:Wait()
		end)
		
		if not ok then
			warn("[GUNBOT] Error anim: "..err)
		end
		
		hum.WalkSpeed = 15
		shooting = false
		
		if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 and runTrack then
			runTrack:Play()
		elseif idleTrack then
			idleTrack:Play()
		end
	end)
	
	-- MINIGUN TOGGLE EN BUCLE
	miniBtn.TouchTap:Connect(function()
		if shooting or isDying or isTransforming or transformed then return end
		
		if minigunActive then
			print("[GUNBOT] MINIGUN desactivado")
			minigunActive = false
			miniTrack:Stop()
			hum.WalkSpeed = 15
			miniBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 200)
			miniBtn.Text = "MINIGUN"
			
			if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 and runTrack then
				runTrack:Play()
			elseif idleTrack then
				idleTrack:Play()
			end
		else
			print("[GUNBOT] MINIGUN activado")
			minigunActive = true
			
			if runTrack then runTrack:Stop() end
			if idleTrack then idleTrack:Stop() end
			
			hum.WalkSpeed = 0
			miniBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30)
			miniBtn.Text = "STOP"
			
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				miniTrack:Play()
			end)
			
			if not ok then
				warn("[GUNBOT] Error anim: "..err)
				minigunActive = false
				hum.WalkSpeed = 15
				miniBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 200)
				miniBtn.Text = "MINIGUN"
			end
		end
	end)
	
	-- DEATH(RESET) - REPRODUCE ANIM Y MATA
	deathBtn.TouchTap:Connect(function()
		if isDying or shooting or minigunActive or isTransforming then return end
		isDying = true
		
		print("[GUNBOT] DEATH(RESET) activado")
		
		if runTrack then runTrack:Stop() end
		if idleTrack then idleTrack:Stop() end
		if miniTrack then miniTrack:Stop() end
		if transformedShotTrack then transformedShotTrack:Stop() end
		
		hum.WalkSpeed = 0
		hum.JumpPower = 0
		
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			deathTrack:Play()
			deathTrack.Stopped:Wait()
		end)
		
		if not ok then
			warn("[GUNBOT] Error anim muerte: "..err)
		end
		
		hum.Health = 0
	end)
	
	-- TRANSFORM - CAMBIA A MODO TRANSFORMADO
	transformBtn.TouchTap:Connect(function()
		if isTransforming or shooting or minigunActive or isDying or transformed then return end
		isTransforming = true
		
		print("[GUNBOT] TRANSFORM activado")
		
		if runTrack then runTrack:Stop() end
		if idleTrack then idleTrack:Stop() end
		if miniTrack then miniTrack:Stop() end
		
		hum.WalkSpeed = 0
		
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			transformTrack:Play()
			transformTrack.Stopped:Wait()
		end)
		
		if not ok then
			warn("[GUNBOT] Error anim transform: "..err)
		end
		
		-- Cambiar a modo transformado
		transformed = true
		currentIdleId = TRANSFORMED_IDLE_ID
		currentRunId = TRANSFORMED_RUN_ID
		loadMovementAnims()
		
		-- Quitar botones normales
		for _, btn in pairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
			if btn.Name == "NormalBtn" then
				btn.Visible = false
			end
		end
		transformBtn.Visible = false
		
		-- Mostrar botón SHOT y TRANSFORM NORMAL
		transformedShotBtn.Visible = true
		normalTransformBtn.Visible = true
		
		hum.WalkSpeed = 15
		
		if idleTrack then
			task.wait(0.1)
			idleTrack:Play()
		end
		
		isTransforming = false
	end)
	
	-- TRANSFORM NORMAL - VUELVE A FORMA BASE CON ANIM INVERTIDA
	normalTransformBtn.TouchTap:Connect(function()
		if isTransforming or shooting or minigunActive or isDying or not transformed then return end
		isTransforming = true
		
		print("[GUNBOT] TRANSFORM NORMAL activado")
		
		if runTrack then runTrack:Stop() end
		if idleTrack then idleTrack:Stop() end
		if transformedShotTrack then transformedShotTrack:Stop() end
		transformedShooting = false
		
		hum.WalkSpeed = 0
		
		-- Reproducir anim de transformación INVERTIDA
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			transformTrack:Play()
			transformTrack:AdjustSpeed(-1) -- VELOCIDAD NEGATIVA = ANIM EN REVERSA
			transformTrack.Stopped:Wait()
			transformTrack:AdjustSpeed(1) -- RESETEAR VELOCIDAD
		end)
		
		if not ok then
			warn("[GUNBOT] Error anim transform normal: "..err)
		end
		
		-- Volver a modo normal
		transformed = false
		currentIdleId = IDLE_ANIM_ID
		currentRunId = RUN_ANIM_ID
		loadMovementAnims()
		
		-- Mostrar botones normales
		for _, btn in pairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
			if btn.Name == "NormalBtn" then
				btn.Visible = true
			end
		end
		transformBtn.Visible = true
		
		-- Quitar botones transformados
		transformedShotBtn.Visible = false
		normalTransformBtn.Visible = false
		transformedShotBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		transformedShotBtn.Text = "SHOT"
		
		hum.WalkSpeed = 15
		
		if idleTrack then
			task.wait(0.1)
			idleTrack:Play()
		end
		
		isTransforming = false
	end)
	
	-- SHOT TRANSFORMADO - TOGGLE EN BUCLE
	transformedShotBtn.TouchTap:Connect(function()
		if isTransforming or isDying then return end
		
		if transformedShooting then
			print("[GUNBOT] SHOT TRANSFORMADO desactivado")
			transformedShooting = false
			transformedShotTrack:Stop()
			transformedShotBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
			transformedShotBtn.Text = "SHOT"
			
			if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 and runTrack then
				runTrack:Play()
			elseif idleTrack then
				idleTrack:Play()
			end
		else
			print("[GUNBOT] SHOT TRANSFORMADO activado")
			transformedShooting = true
			
			if runTrack then runTrack:Stop() end
			if idleTrack then idleTrack:Stop() end
			
			transformedShotBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
			transformedShotBtn.Text = "STOP"
			
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				transformedShotTrack:Play()
			end)
			
			if not ok then
				warn("[GUNBOT] Error anim shot transformado: "..err)
				transformedShooting = false
				transformedShotBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
				transformedShotBtn.Text = "SHOT"
			end
		end
	end)
end
